facts.text: The resort is at 1 Lake Oconee Trail in Greensboro, Georgia.
facts.excerpt: 1 Lake Oconee Trail, Greensboro, Georgia, USA, 30642

facts.text: Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport is the closest airport, listed at about 75 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: ATL is located approximately 75.0 Miles from the hotel.

facts.text: The land the resort sits on was once the family hunting retreat of Mercer Reynolds Sr.
facts.excerpt: The land on which the resort sits was once the family hunting retreat of Mercer Reynolds Sr.

facts.text: Animal-print throw pillows in the rooms nod to the area's hunting-plantation past.
facts.excerpt: Animal-print throw pillows in the rooms nod to the area’s hunting-plantation past

facts.text: Fireside Rooms and Suites have a private patio with a fire pit overlooking Lake Oconee.
facts.excerpt: where you can enjoy unwinding by a fire pit on your private patio overlooking Lake Oconee

facts.text: The Lake House is a three-story, four-bedroom lakefront residence.
facts.excerpt: The three-story, four-bedroom lake-front residence is a modern and elegant home

facts.text: Lake House and Cottage guests have a dedicated Cottage Concierge to curate their stay.
facts.excerpt: including a dedicated Cottage Concierge, available to curate your stay and arrange memorable experiences throughout the resort.

facts.text: The multi-level Club Lounge has light-wood furnishings, a stack-stone fireplace and a lake-view patio.
facts.excerpt: The multi-level Club Lounge brings nature indoors with its light-wood furnishings and soft, lake-inspired tones. Enjoy locally inspired food and beverage offerings around the stack-stone fireplace or on the lake-view patio.

facts.text: Club Lounge access requires an upgraded Club booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite status does not include it.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.

facts.text: Linger Longer Steakhouse has a lake house setting with views of the Georgia pines and the Oconee Course.
facts.excerpt: Savor prime cuts, fresh seafood, and signature sides in a warm, lake house setting with views of the Georgia pines and the Oconee Course.

facts.text: Amore del Lago is an Italian restaurant serving homemade pastas and wood-fired pizzas.
facts.excerpt: Amore del Lago is our Italian restaurant in Lake Oconee, Georgia, offering authentic cuisine, including homemade pastas, wood-fired pizzas, and classic Italian dishes inspired by family recipes.

facts.text: Oconee Cove is a speakeasy lounge tucked away off the resort lobby.
facts.excerpt: Nestled discreetly off the resort’s lobby behind a hidden nook, Oconee Cove is a sophisticated speakeasy lounge

facts.text: Gaby's by the Lake serves lobster grilled cheese, BBQ pork nachos and seasonal salads beside the Infinity Pool.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the water and nestled beside the resort’s Infinity Pool at Lake Oconee, this restaurant on the water serves up relaxed favorites with elevated flair, including favorites such as lobster grilled cheese

facts.text: Docks-to-Go lets guests on a boat order Gaby's by the Lake food for dockside delivery.
facts.excerpt: Place your order from the comfort of your boat and enjoy a delicious meal delivered dockside.

facts.text: Guests can try the Golf Ball Massage, which uses a heated golf ball much like a hot stone.
facts.excerpt: Try the Golf Ball Massage, which incorporates a heated golf ball much like a hot stone to loosen tight muscles.

facts.text: The spa is 27,000 square feet and includes a salon and nail area.
facts.excerpt: our newly transformed spa spans 27,000 square feet, featuring redesigned spaces and innovative treatments

facts.text: The Infinity Pool is for guests ages 12 and older from May 21 through Labor Day Weekend and open to all guests the rest of the year.
facts.excerpt: Available to guests ages 12 and older from May 21 through Labor Day Weekend. Open to all guests for the remainder of the year.

facts.text: The Family Pool has interactive features such as geysers and splash pads.
facts.excerpt: With interactive features like geysers and splash pads, the Family Pool is so much more than just a pool

facts.text: Ritz Kids is designed for children aged five to 12 and covers tent-building and fishing techniques.
facts.excerpt: Designed for kids aged five to 12, Ritz Kids introduces guests to the great outdoors through tent-building and fishing techniques

facts.text: The Linger Longer Express is a complimentary ten-minute ride around the resort on an eco-efficient locomotive.
facts.excerpt: Explore scenic areas of the resort with a complimentary ten-minute ride in the one-of-a-kind, eco-efficient locomotive

facts.text: Registered hotel guests get a complimentary s'mores celebration each evening at The Backyard campfire, weather permitting.
facts.excerpt: Gather under the stars for a complimentary s’mores celebration each evening.

facts.text: The Falconry Encounter offers hands-on interaction with birds of prey guided by expert handlers.
facts.excerpt: The Falconry Encounter invites guests to connect with nature through hands-on interactions with majestic birds of prey, guided by expert handlers

facts.text: The Aerial Adventure Course has treetop obstacles, rope bridges and a zip line.
facts.excerpt: the Aerial Adventure Course offers a high-flying challenge with treetop obstacles, rope bridges, and a zip line

facts.text: Guests can go on a sunset voyage aboard the Lovely Lady, a classic wooden boat.
facts.excerpt: Experience a serene sunset voyage on the Lovely Lady, a classic wooden boat

facts.text: Four architects (Rees Jones, Jack Nicklaus, Tom Fazio and Bob Cupp) designed the resort's five championship golf courses.
facts.excerpt: four legendary architects — Rees Jones, Jack Nicklaus, Tom Fazio, and Bob Cupp —designed the resort’s five championship golf courses

facts.text: The Kingdom at Reynolds Lake Oconee offers TaylorMade custom club fittings, private instruction and same-day club building on-site.
facts.excerpt: In collaboration with TaylorMade, The Kingdom at Reynolds Lake Oconee offers custom club fittings, private instruction with the industry’s best, and same-day club building on-site.

facts.text: Shuttle service to all golf courses is included in the Resort Fee.
facts.excerpt: Shuttle service to all golf courses is included in the Resort Fee.

facts.text: Complimentary bike rentals are included in the Resort Fee.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary bike rentals within the Resort Fee.

facts.text: The resort is exclusively cashless; guests must present a credit card at check-in.
facts.excerpt: The resort is exclusively cashless; guests must present a credit card at check-in

facts.text: Parking is valet only.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking only.

facts.text: Pets are welcome, with a non-refundable pet fee per stay.
facts.excerpt: A non-refundable pet fee of $150.00 per stay applies.

facts.text: The resort holds an AAA Five Diamond rating for 2026.
facts.excerpt: AAA Five Diamond Hotel, 2026

facts.text: Reynolds Lake Oconee golf is described as offering 90 holes across five courses.
facts.excerpt: the five championship Lake Oconee golf courses offer 90 holes of play

facts.text: The resort offers access to five championship golf courses with 99 holes of play.
facts.excerpt: The resort offers access to five championship golf courses with 99 holes of play between them.

contradictions.note: p6 says 90 holes of play, p11 says 99 holes
